builder_self_score_ignored: self-score.json claims 8.0~8.3 per axis; not supported by the frames. The gap to Kingshot is a full tier, not detail-level.

camera: 1280: the plateau+battle occupy only the center ~35% of the frame; the rest is a flat green plane dotted with boulders. Reads as a floating diorama island seen from far away. Kingshot 1280 frames (gp_1, Vioib7IWvqc f024, ArdQULLJJU4 f022) are zoomed in so units/buildings fill the frame and the world runs off every edge.
Scale break: outer-ring boulders at 1280 are bigger than the barracks/gate buildings on the plateau, so the eye reads 'toy model on a table' instead of 'valley with cliffs'.

390: pitch is close to top-down and the whole U-shaped track is framed like a board-game map; Kingshot as_12/ref-1 cut the path diagonally out of frame, cliffs cropped at the edge, giving depth and motion.
lighting: Grass (plateau top and lower plain) is one flat unlit color with no low-frequency value variation, no visible cast shadows from trees, towers, gates or the king. Kingshot: every tree/tower/wall throws a soft cool-teal shadow and grass has gentle light/shade variation.

Cliff walls are a near-black flat navy slab with no warm-top/cool-side temperature split and no baked AO gradient at the foot; the plateau lip is a smooth bright-green rounded tube that looks like plastic. Kingshot cliffs: pale sandstone tops, blue-grey faces, faceted planes lit differently.
Boulders are generic faceted low-poly with default diffuse; no rim/soft wrap. Baked AO is not perceptible at gameplay zoom.
palette: Closest axis. Grass green, red horde, blue horde, teal river, beige boulders are on-bible.
Lower plain and plateau top are almost the same green, so levels don't separate; enemy zone pink is flat and small.
Coins read as orange dots rather than bright gold #F2B705 with highlight.
terrain: Outer ring = boulders scattered like polka dots and single trees sprinkled evenly. Kingshot masses rocks into continuous cliff ridges and clusters trees into groves; ours has no clustering or silhouette.
Plateau interior is a large empty mint field (between pad and king) - exactly what the bible forbids. Kingshot fills with paths, fences, crates, tower bases.
Dirt road under the hordes is thin and hidden; no wheel ruts or soft edge. River is a flat stripe with no bank rocks or foam.
characters: Horde as mass reads well (red/blue texture at ~1.4% height) - the strongest element.
The king is a tiny white/grey figure with an orange cylinder behind him, unreadable as hero; Kingshot's king is 2x soldier size with gold crown, blue cape and a selection ring.
Giants read as grey-helmeted boxes; soldiers lack the big-round-helmet + spear-glint silhouette that makes Kingshot's crowd sparkle.
vfx: Clash line has only a few small white sparks, grey smoke puffs and orange dots. Kingshot: large white-blue 4-point starburst with rays, blue projectile streaks, and a carpet of gold coins lying on the ground along the fight line.
Bolts from towers are thin faint lines; no hit flash on units, no -N damage pops visible, no death flashes at gameplay zoom.
Pour beam = a flat yellow line from king to pad inside a yellow ring - reads as a debug gizmo, not a coin stream.
ui: Top of 390 is 4 HUD pills + a large dark navy text box (2-4 lines + timer sub-line + penalty sub-line + progress bar) covering ~25% of the screen. Bible F forbids info boxes; Kingshot has one coin pill only.

Tutorial chips ('답만큼 붓기', '① 멈춰 서기', '분모', '분자') are dark screen-space style pills floating over the world, overlapping each other at 1280 (분자 on top of 분모). build-1280.png shows the feedback text overlapping the timer line inside the banner (text collision bug).
Pack selector and victory are generic dark-navy rounded-rectangle modals with system-ish type; Kingshot uses chunky outlined display type, ribbons, bright blue/gold framing.

top_fixes.gap: Question panel is a dark info box (25% of 390 height) with timer text, penalty text and progress bar; world is dimmed/crowded under it.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Screen-space UI is a single grey pill (coin count); everything else lives in the world.
top_fixes.fix: Turn the question into a cream parchment ribbon/plaque (#F6E7C8 fill, #5A3A1E 3px outline, rounded ends, slight curl) with bold outlined text ≥17px; move timer into a small circular hourglass badge on the ribbon's right end and the penalty text into a red -3 pop over the gate HP pill when it happens. Remove the separate progress bar (use the ribbon's bottom edge fill). Auto-collapse to 1 line (+ '더 읽기') after 3 s of reading on 390. Fix the text overlap seen in build-1280.png.

top_fixes.gap: 1280 shows the whole plateau as a small island in the center of a flat green plane; boulders out-scale buildings.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Camera close enough that units, towers and pads fill the frame; world bleeds off all edges.
top_fixes.fix: Drive camera distance by horizontal FOV at landscape: target plateau width = ~75% of screen width at 1280 (≈1.8x closer), keep pitch 50-55°, offset look-at so the horde path enters from the top-right edge. Scale outer boulders down to ≤1.5x the barracks and group them into ridges hugging the plateau instead of scattering over the plain.

top_fixes.gap: No perceptible cast shadows and flat unlit grass; cliff faces are black slabs.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Soft cool-teal shadows under every tree/tower/wall/character; warm sandstone cliff tops, blue-grey faces; grass has soft value variation.
top_fixes.fix: Enable one directional light shadow (2 cascades off, 1024 map, soft PCF, distance clamp to the plateau) with shadow color tinted #2C6A5A via custom lit shader (lerp base→tint by shadow attenuation instead of multiplying to black). Add blob-shadow quads (α0.35) for the horde via the same instanced material. Bake a low-frequency noise/AO into the grass vertex colors (subdivide plateau and plain meshes to ~1 m grid) ±6% value. Recolor cliff material: top band #E9C9B0, face gradient #838894→#263945 by world-Y, with baked AO at the base.

top_fixes.gap: Clash line is quiet: few small sparks, grey puffs, orange dots; pour beam is a flat yellow line.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Big white-blue 4-point starbursts with light rays at the front, blue projectile streaks, gold coins spilling and lying flat on the ground.
top_fixes.fix: Pooled additive quad bursts (64 max) at the contact band: 4-point star sprite 1.5x soldier height + 6 radial ray quads, 0.18 s life, 8-12 per second. Coins: instanced flat gold discs (#F2B705 top, #DD9A1E rim) that pop out with arc and lie on the ground for 6 s, collected by a magnet toward the king. Replace the yellow pour line with a stream of 6-10 instanced coins arcing from the king to the pad, and a pad-fill ring that grows.

top_fixes.gap: Empty mint field inside the plateau and polka-dot boulders/trees outside.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Clustered groves (3-9 trees), continuous rock ridges, and the play area filled with paths, fences, props.
top_fixes.fix: Place outer props by clustered Poisson sampling: rock ridges (3 sizes merged into one static-batched mesh per ridge) along the plateau skirt and map edges; tree groves of 3-9 via GPU instancing. Inside the plateau add a dirt path loop from king spawn to each pad (#C8B59C, soft alpha edges, 2 lighter rut lines), a fenced yard around the barracks with blue-painted rail tops, crate/barrel/sack clusters and 2 torches; keep a clear 2 m radius around pads for readability.

top_fixes.gap: The king is tiny, grey-white and unreadable with an orange cylinder behind him.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Hero is ~2.2x soldier size, gold crown, blue cape, bright ground ring - the eye finds him instantly.
top_fixes.fix: Scale king to 2.2x soldier height, give a gold crown + blue cape + white outline-less rim (fresnel in shader), add a pulsing blue ground ring (decal quad) and remove/replace the orange cylinder with a stacked-coins backpack that visibly grows with the coin count.

top_fixes.gap: Tutorial chips are screen-style dark pills that overlap each other (분모/분자) and float far from what they label; ghost hand is a cream bunny-like shape.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Pads carry their own price label in the pad; guidance is a green arrow/ghost hand in-world.
top_fixes.fix: Put the role label (분모/분자) as bold outlined white text painted inside the top edge of each pad (world-space TMP on the pad plane) and the big number in the center. Replace chips with a bouncing green 3D arrow over the next pad and a white semi-transparent hand sprite with dark outline doing the hold gesture; show '멈춰 서서 붓기' as a small speech bubble above the king only on first use. Add anti-overlap layout for any remaining world labels.

top_fixes.gap: Plateau lip is a smooth bright-green tube and the lower plain is the same green, so height levels don't read.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Clear level separation: grass edge breaks into faceted rock at the drop, lower ground slightly darker/cooler, distance fog tint.
top_fixes.fix: Replace the rounded lip with a faceted rock rim mesh (sandstone top, grey face) and grass overhang tufts; tint the lower plain #208F61→#0D7461 with a cool height fog (teal #BFE6E0, start 25 m) so the plateau pops.

top_fixes.gap: Pack selector and victory are generic dark navy modals.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Chunky outlined display type, bright blue/gold framed panels, ribbons, reward icons.
top_fixes.fix: Restyle modals: light parchment or bright blue panel with thick dark outline, a gold ribbon header, outlined display font (subset woff2 in the build), star/crown reward icons for victory, confetti of coins. Keep dark only as a 40% scrim behind.

top_fixes.gap: No per-unit hit feedback: no white hit flash, no -N pops, no HP bars on hit giants/gate at gameplay zoom.
top_fixes.kingshot_does: Red/green HP bars over hit entities, white damage numbers, white flash on death.
top_fixes.fix: Instanced per-unit flash via a material property (hitTime) in the soldier shader; pooled world-space -N number quads (bitmap font atlas) over giants/gate; small HP bars only on giants, gate, towers.

education_banner_proposal: The question cannot be removed, so make it look like a game object: a curled parchment scroll/ribbon hanging from the top edge (like a quest scroll in a strategy game), rounded chunky Korean type with dark outline, 1-2 lines at 390 by default with tap-to-expand. Timer = a small hourglass medallion clipped to the scroll's right end that drains; penalty = a red '-3' that flies from the medallion to the gate pill. Correct/incorrect feedback = the scroll flips to a green/red stamped seal for 1.2 s instead of replacing text in the box. At 1280 the scroll sits top-center at ≤45% width, never over the battle.
notes: Independent verdict: FAIL (mean 5.63, 7 axes below 7). The horde-as-mass and the base palette are on target; everything that makes Kingshot look 'premium' - soft tinted shadows, clustered terrain masses, big flashy clash VFX, gold coins on the ground, a readable hero, and nearly-invisible screen UI - is missing or weak. At 1280 the far camera makes it look like a diorama prototype. The build's self-score (8.0-8.3) overstates by ~2.5 points per axis. Highest leverage order: (1) camera distance + outer-ring re-layout at 1280, (2) tinted soft shadows + grass variation + cliff material, (3) clash VFX + ground coins, (4) question banner → scroll + world-space labels, (5) hero king. Also noted a real UI bug: build-1280.png feedback text overlaps the timer line inside the banner. No console errors during judge capture.
